newsitem.title: UK: Amersham up on planned merger.
newsitem.headline: Amersham up on planned merger.

text.p: Shares in Amersham International Plc jumped on Tuesday, after the British health care group said it would merge its life science units with them of Pharmacia & Upjohn.
By 0815 GMT, Amersham shares were up 94p to 14.45 stg, nudging the stock's all time high at 14.45-1/4.
"The outlook seems to be very, very bright", one trader said, referring to he planned merger.
Earlier, Amersham said the merger would generate savings of more than 30 million stg.

Apart form this, Amersham said it was confident that in future years, sales and profit growth would maintain the underlying momentum achieved in the past financial year. For 1997, ending March 31, it reported a 30 percent growth in pre-tax profits to 65.8 million stg.
